stem:
A classmate offers Soham a cigarette and says trying it once will do no harm.

What should Soham do?

options.text: Refuse it from the first offer, because tobacco is harmful and addictive.
Refuse it only if it is an illegal drug; tobacco need not be refused.
Try it if he has no breathing difficulty.
Try it once, because one cigarette cannot cause harm.

teacher.key_rationale: Tobacco is harmful and addictive, so it should be refused from the first offer. Illegal-drug-only narrows the domain; waiting for breathing difficulty uses a late symptom; a single try is still unsafe.
